cards.title: Teléfono y libreta como símbolo de comunicación profesional
cards.description: Consistent AgntiaPro art direction: warm editorial European design magazine, ivory #fcfaf6, ink #242421, subtle violet #6550dd and champagne gold #b49665 only as accents, beautiful natural materials, refined realism, quiet cinematic light, generous negative space, excellent photographic composition. No readable text, letters, logos, branding, UI, watermarks, neon, futuristic dashboards, stock-photo clichés. Elegant modern smartphone face down next to a handwritten notebook and a cup of tea on a calm warm desk, an open doorway and daylight beyond, natural realistic textures, human-centered communication, premium editorial composition.
